rules.problem: check_for is a flat list of single items. The page requires scrotal swelling/pain WITH a modifier, so standalone swelling, pain, trauma and testicle position will fire. It also includes non-urgent items (painless lump, glans inflamed) and uses urethral discharge as trigger.

rules.problem: Trigger includes urethral discharge, which is the non-urgent branch; otherwise structure (finding AND one of three likely diagnoses) matches the red box.

summary: The urgent check task is the main problem: it lists standalone fragments (swelling, pain, trauma) that the page only accepts in combination, and includes non-urgent items (painless lump, glans inflamed) plus urethral discharge as a trigger. The three diagnosis rules for torsion, paraphimosis and priapism and the Urgent priority rule faithfully follow the red box, apart from the urethral-discharge trigger. Remaining issues are minor concept breadth (generic Traumatic injury, Testes - transverse lie for rotated) and the >= versus > 4 hours boundary.
